title: ONFO / Dr. J.R. Forsyth Bitcoin Treasure Hunt

author.name: Dr. John Forsyth (Onfo LLC, persona "Dr. J.R. Forsyth")

prize.note: reported in contemporaneous coverage as funded from the author's personal funds, not a company treasury

target_format: a Bitcoin private key, format not specified by the author (WIF or hex), matching P2PKH address 157dpLJgAAKugukKz8UwBHapM4idyZvnLc

derivation.summary: the author stated a private key is hidden "in plain sight" somewhere in the visual or audio content of 10 video segments, all required together; no decoding method, cipher, or steganographic technique was ever specified, and only 5 of the 10 segments were ever published

difficulty_note: half of the announced material (segments 6 to 10) was never published, and the sole self-declared key holder died in 2023; no known method applies to an incomplete corpus
